description: A machine in a time window: its confirmations in the window (value references by the machine key), the orders they were for, its planned jobs, and its signals.
isa95: ISA-95 2018 Part 4 Work Record (WorkRecordSpecification; InformationObjectType). Norm source in the repo: B2MML 0701 B2MML-WorkRecord.xsd (incorporated from ISA-88 Part 4 / 880004 Batch Production Record). Paths come from standard/contract.json, never a path language of our own.
